# Wayground

> Wayground (formerly Quizizz) is an AI-powered teacher platform providing assessment tools, curriculum resources, and content generators for K-12 education.

Wayground serves teachers and school districts with standards-aligned educational content, interactive video libraries, and AI-powered tools for lesson planning, assessment, and differentiation. The platform integrates with popular classroom tools like Google Classroom and supports accessibility features for diverse learners.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered teaching tools
- Standards-aligned curriculum
- K-12 education
- Assessment and grading
- Lesson planning
- Video library
- Math curriculum
- Teacher resources
- Classroom management
- Student accommodations
- Common Core
- Virginia SOL
- Google Classroom integration
- Free educational tools
- Differentiated learning

- [Choose Your Plan](https://wayground.com/home/plans): Flexible pricing plans for teachers and districts with feature comparison

## AI Content Generators

- [AI Lesson Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/lesson-plan-generator): Free AI lesson plan generator for K-12 teachers by grade and subject
- [AI Unit Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/unit-plan-generator): Free AI generator for personalized unit plans by subject and grade
- [Weekly Lesson Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/weekly-plan-generator): AI tool to create customized weekly lesson plans for any subject
- [Free AI Multiple Choice Questions Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/multiple-choice-question-generator): AI generator for customized multiple choice quizzes across subjects
- [AI Rubric Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/rubric-generator): AI tool to create customized rubrics aligned to standards
- [Free AI Presentation Maker](https://wayground.com/generators/ai-presentation-maker): AI tool to create personalized presentations for any subject or grade
- [Free Worksheet Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/worksheet-generator): AI worksheet generator for math and vocabulary across grade levels
- [AI Math Problem Generator](http://wayground.com/generators/math-problem-generator): AI tool to generate customized math problems by grade and difficulty

## Video Library

- [Math Videos Library](https://wayground.com/video-library/math): Interactive math video library organized by topic and grade level
- [Kindergarten Math Videos](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/kindergarten-math): Kindergarten math videos covering counting, place value, and geometry
- [1st Grade Math Videos](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/1st-grade-math): 1st grade math videos on addition, subtraction, and place value
- [2nd Grade Math Videos](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/2nd-grade-math): 2nd grade math videos covering arithmetic and foundational concepts
- [3rd Grade Math Videos](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/3rd-grade-math): 3rd grade math videos on multiplication, division, and fractions
- [4th Grade Math Videos](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/4th-grade-math): 4th grade math videos on fractions, decimals, and multiplication
- [5th Grade Math Videos](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/5th-grade-math): 5th grade math videos on decimals, fractions, and advanced concepts

## Standards-Based Practice Tests

- [Virginia SOL Practice Test](https://wayground.com/home/state-test-prep/virginia-sol-practice-test): Virginia SOL practice test with AI grading and accessibility features
